description:
Analysis extent for Flood, Pakistan, 10 September 2014 (FL20140910PAK): 4 features merged from 4 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Flood Waters in Chiniot Area, Punjab Province, Pakistan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-flood-waters-in-chiniot-area-punjab-province-pakistan-september-16-2014)
- [Geodata of Overview of Flood Waters in Multan area, Punjab Province, Pakistan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-overview-of-flood-waters-in-multan-area-punjab-province-pakistan-september-15-2014)
- [Geodata of Overview of Flood Waters in Puran-Fatehpur area, Punjab Province, Pakistan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-overview-of-flood-waters-in-puran-fatehpur-area-punjab-province-pa-september-12-2014)
- [Geodata of Overview of Flood Waters in Wazirabad area, Punjab Province, Pakistan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-overview-of-flood-waters-in-wazirabad-area-punjab-province-pakista-september-11-2014)
- [Geodata of Standing Waters in Tarind Muhammed Panah  Area, Punjab Province, Pakistan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-standing-waters-in-tarind-muhammed-panah-area-punjab-province-paki-september-17-2014)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Worldview-1; 2 = Worldview-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = Komsat-2; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT-6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 55 = VG; 66 = CJ; 77 = LD; 88 = HK; 99 = ER; 100 = KM; 111 = MBF; 121 = CN; 131 = SB; 222 = CS; 1000 = Unknown. The decoded text is in `StaffID_label`.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
